name: 100 Lives
detailed_description:
Welcome to Kingstown, where your toddler years might involve tax fraud, your teenage phase could end in a cult, and adulthood is… optional (not really). In 100 Lives, every few hours is a brand-new lifetime and every choice you make can come back to haunt (or smooch) you.

You’ll start with a simple question: Who am I this time?

Customise your character: pick your look, your vibe, your emotional baggage and dive headfirst into a life that could involve prom drama, vampire book clubs, underground fight rings, or just a really bad job interview. Then it all ends. And you’re reborn. Possibly as your ex’s babysitter.

Each life you live unlocks new memories, skills, and strange little heirlooms that shape what’s possible next time. Maybe you were a gardener. Now you're a mafia boss with a passion for plants and a plan to grow the organic drug empire of your dreams. Maybe you played gigs as a musician, ran a flower shop, and built a massive music festival in the haunted strawberry fields. The more lives you stack up, the weirder the combos get.

This isn’t just a life sim. It’s a life remix machine. Part roguelike. Part sandbox. Part “how did I get here and why is my best friend a ghost raccoon?”

But it’s not just about you. The city evolves too. Gangs shift power. Ghosts gain hobbies. The mall becomes sentient (maybe). And the people you meet, friends, enemies, chaotic situationships might remember you in the next life… even if you don’t remember them.

No two lifetimes are the same. Unless you really try. (And even then, probably not.)
Unlock weird skills, awkward heirlooms, and deeply questionable career paths across timelines. Think of it as your personal multiverse, just with more dodgeball-related trauma and less cosmic responsibility.

Your journey doesn’t end with one life. It ends with 100.
Or maybe 103 if we get weird with patch notes.

Want the inside scoop on Kingstown’s weirdest moments?

Let Emily (Kingstown’s aspiring influencer and local chaos magnet) be your guide:

  • Join Discord – share theories, pitch timelines, uncover secrets

  • Follow on TikTok – gossip, conspiracies, cryptid sightings

  • Follow on Instagram – life advice, glitchy moments, questionable “facts”

short_description: What would you do with 100 lives? In this fast-paced life-sim, every life is a brand-new existence. Fall in love, start a cult, become a hero (or a disaster). Your choices shape the world... and yourself... across lifetimes.
supported_languages:
English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Portuguese - Portugal*, Simplified Chinese*, Spanish - Latin America*, Traditional Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 and Windows 11
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support.
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX or OpenGL compatible card
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: High Sierra 10.13+
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 1024 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX or OpenGL compatible card
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
